install.title: MailArchive
install.subtitle: Initial setup — organization, administrator, and where data is stored.
install.sectionDataHint: SQLite is fine for demos. MySQL for production. If you change the engine from the current one, restart the API and finish install.
install.restartHint: A database change is pending: restart the API and complete installation.
install.tenantModeHint: Single: one organization (login without tenant field). Multi: users enter the slug.
install.passwordHint: A password change will be required on first login.

register.title: Create user
register.subtitle: Enter your details. You will receive a link valid for 48 hours to set your password.
register.name: Full name
register.emailHint: Use the real mailbox address for your organization.

setPassword.invalidToken: The link is invalid or expired.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.subtitle: Required on first access or after a reset.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcome: Welcome. Use the side menu to link accounts and archive mail.

accounts.title: Mail accounts
accounts.subtitleStaff: All tenant accounts. Others are marked.
accounts.subtitleUser: Link Microsoft 365 or IMAP. You can add several.
accounts.empty: No linked accounts. Use + to link one.
accounts.linkHint: Microsoft 365 opens OAuth (pick the account). Gmail uses IMAP + an App Password. Generic IMAP needs host, port, SSL, and mailbox password.
accounts.gmailAppPasswordHint: Gmail: use an App Password (Google Account → Security → App passwords), not your normal password. Host: imap.gmail.com · port 993 · SSL.
accounts.unlinked: Account unlinked. Archived mail was kept.
accounts.unlinkMessage: Unlink {email}? Credentials are removed; archived mail is kept.
accounts.transferMessage: Transfer {email} to another user. Archived mail will be reassigned to them.
accounts.scheduleHint: Schedule archiving of new mail for {email} across all mailbox folders. This is not sync: it only copies into the local archive (never deletes from the provider by default).
accounts.scheduleHistoricalHint: Besides new mail, each run also walks older messages (up to the limit) until the full mailbox history is archived.
accounts.hardDeleteMessage: Remove the link for {email}? Only allowed when there is no archived mail. EML is never purged from here.
accounts.purgeMessage: This will permanently delete {n} archived message(s) for {email} (EML + database) and remove the link. Irreversible.

archive.title: Archive
archive.subtitle: Pick an account and folder, list messages, and archive one by one.
archive.subject: Subject
archive.confirmBody: A copy will be saved to the local archive.
archive.deleteWarning: Irreversible in the mailbox. The local archive is kept.
archive.doneAlready: Message was already in the archive.

bulk.title: Bulk archive
bulk.subtitle: Criteria → simulate → review → archive.
bulk.jobsHint: Archiving runs in the background. You can keep using the app.
bulk.jobResultSummary: Newly archived: {archived}. Skipped (already in archive): {skipped}. Failed: {failed}.
bulk.skippedHint: Listed in the mailbox but not saved again because they already exist in the local archive.
bulk.noSampleOldJob: This job predates per-message detail; only counters are available.

bulkPreview.title: Preview
bulkPreview.subtitle: Uncheck what you do not want to archive, then start the job.
bulkPreview.willDelete: Will be deleted from the provider.
bulkPreview.subject: Subject
bulkPreview.confirmDelete: Selected messages will be archived and DELETED from the provider. Continue?
bulkPreview.confirmKeep: Selected messages will be archived and kept in the mailbox. Continue?

mails.title: Archived mail
mails.subtitle: Search, multi-select to download (ZIP), restore, or delete from the archive.
mails.deleteMessage: Removes the local archive copy (EML + database). Does not restore to the mailbox. Scheduled jobs will not re-download it.
mails.bulkDeleteMessage: Delete {n} message(s) from the local archive. They are not restored to the mailbox. Jobs will not re-download them.
mails.deletedOne: Removed from archive. It will not be auto-archived again.
mails.subject: Subject
mails.restoreMessage: It will be restored to the provider and removed from MailArchive.
mails.restoreMessageKeep: It will be restored to the provider and kept in MailArchive (backup).
mails.keepCopyLabel: Keep a copy in the app
mails.keepCopyHint: Off by default. If enabled, the message stays in the local archive.
mails.bulkRestoreMessage: {n} message(s) will be restored and removed from the local archive.
mails.bulkRestoreMessageKeep: {n} message(s) will be restored and kept in the local archive.
mails.restoredOne: Restored to «{folder}» and removed from local archive.
mails.restoredOneKept: Restored to «{folder}». The copy was kept in MailArchive.
mails.restoredBulk: Restored {n} message(s) and removed from local archive.
mails.restoredBulkKept: Restored {n} message(s); copies were kept in MailArchive.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Create, edit, and reset access.
users.name: Name
users.createdSent: User {email} created. A password link was sent.
users.createdNoEmail: User {email} created. Email not sent: {detail}. Copy the link below (valid 48h).
users.resetFail: Could not send email: {detail}. Copy the link below (valid 48h).
users.setupUrlHint: Select and copy. The link is invalidated when used or after 48 hours.
users.resetMessage: Send {email} a link to set a new password?
users.deactivateMessage: Deactivate {email}? They will not be able to sign in. Choose what to do with their linked accounts.
users.restoreMessage: Reactivate {email}? They will be able to sign in again.
users.hardDeleteMessage: Permanently delete {email}? This cannot be undone.
users.hardDeleteArchiveHint: Archived mail is NOT deleted. If they still own accounts, reassign them first.
users.hardDeleteReassignHint: Required if the user still owns accounts (including unlinked).

departure.title: Employee departure
departure.subtitle: Archive the mailbox, transfer or unlink accounts, and deactivate access.
departure.noAccounts: This user has no active accounts. Only access will be deactivated.
departure.archiveEnabled: Archive mailbox history (async jobs; does not delete from provider)
departure.olderThanDays: Only mail older than N days
departure.olderThanDaysHint: Empty = all messages within the limit
departure.disableSchedules: Disable scheduled archive on their accounts
departure.transferRequiredHint: When archiving, transfer accounts (jobs need credentials). You can unlink later.
departure.unlinkOkHint: Without archiving you can unlink and keep the archive, or transfer.
departure.warning: The user will become inactive and cannot sign in. Existing archive is kept.
departure.noJobs: No archive jobs (empty mailbox or archive off)

audit.title: Audit logs
audit.subtitle: Administrators only. Search by action, resource, or detail.
audit.clearMessage: ALL audit logs for this tenant will be deleted. One record will remain noting the clear. Continue?

profile.title: My profile
profile.name: Name
profile.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Please sign in again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Outbound mail, templates, language, data/storage, and appearance.
settings.sectionSmtpHint: SMTP server used to send access and password-reset links.
settings.sectionTemplatesHint: You can write any free text. Variables are replaced when sending. Missing ones become empty.
settings.templatesVarsHelp: {name} = name · {email} = email · {tenant_slug} = organization · {url} = button link · {app_name} = app name
settings.sectionLanguageHint: Language for the whole application (menus, screens, and emails). Packs are discovered from JSON files; add another JSON and it appears in the list.
settings.sectionDataHint: Choose database engine, MySQL credentials, and the EML storage folder. Database changes require an API restart.
settings.tenantModeSingleHint: Login and register without a tenant field; the sole installed organization is used.
settings.tenantModeMultiHint: Login asks for the tenant slug. The last slug is remembered in this browser.
settings.dataDbPasswordHint: Leave blank to keep the stored password.
settings.dataStorageRootHint: Used for filesystem and branding. With S3, mail blobs go to the bucket; branding stays on disk.
settings.storageBackendHint: Local filesystem or S3-compatible (MinIO, AWS, R2, Wasabi).
settings.s3EndpointHint: e.g. http://minio:9000 or empty for AWS.
settings.s3SecretKeyHintSet: Leave blank to keep the stored secret.
settings.dataRestartRequired: Database settings were saved. Restart the API service (e.g. docker compose restart api) to apply them.
settings.sectionMicrosoftHint: Entra ID (Azure AD) app credentials for Microsoft 365 OAuth.
settings.msSecretHint: Leave blank to keep the stored secret. Paste the Azure Value, not the Secret ID (GUID).
settings.sectionAppearanceHint: Logos, sidebar name, and primary UI color.
settings.brandNameHint: Empty = MailArchive. Shown next to the icon in the sidebar.
settings.appearanceSaved: Appearance saved. Navigate again to refresh the theme.
settings.logoHint: Icon: sidebar/favicon. Full logo: login and install. PNG/JPEG/WebP, max 2 MB.
settings.appearanceSoon: Upload custom logos under Settings → Appearance.
settings.passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the stored password.
settings.replyToHint: Optional. Where replies should go if different from From.
settings.localeSaved: Language updated. The UI refreshes with the new language.
settings.addLocaleHint: To add a language: create a JSON file under backend/app/i18n/locales/ (e.g. pt.json) matching es.json / en.json, then restart the API.
settings.subject: Subject

invite.subject: Access to {app_name}
invite.intro: Your {app_name} account was created (organization: {tenant_slug}). Click the button to set your password. The link is valid for 48 hours.
invite.footer: Email: {email}. If you did not request this, ignore this message.
invite.link_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link:

reset.subject: Reset password — {app_name}
reset.intro: We received a request to reset your {app_name} password. Click the button to choose a new one (valid for 48 hours).
reset.footer: Email: {email}. If this was not you, ignore this message.
reset.link_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link:
